Build kit for "button"

This kit is narrowed by --type, so it names no template.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        useClickableContainer
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Makes a container element clickable while preserving nested interactive element behavior.

name:        useInteractiveRole
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Resolves what a polymorphic component should render as, in one place: href wins, then onClick, then an interactive trigger context supplied by a parent (Popover, DropdownMenu and friends), then inert.

name:        useClipboard
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Copy-to-clipboard behavior: the clipboard write, a transient isCopied flag with its own reset timer, and an optional polite screen-reader announcement.

frame:      AppShell, TopNav, SideNav, Layout
